scenarios.title: Load pickup: 0.50 to 0.80 pu
scenarios.plain: A large block of consumers is switched on at once.

scenarios.title: Load rejection: 1.00 to 0.10 pu
scenarios.plain: The turbine suddenly loses 90 % of its load (a breaker opens). The danger is overspeed.

scenarios.title: Block loading: 0.20, 0.45, 0.70, 0.95 pu
scenarios.plain: Load is added in three blocks, as when restoring a grid after a blackout.

scenarios.title: Noisy speed sensor: 0.60 to 0.70 pu
scenarios.plain: A small load change measured with a speed signal five times noisier than normal.
